en.description:
MineSweeper Blast is the perfect minesweeper game designed exclusively for Apple Watch, bringing the classic puzzle experience to your wrist with elegant design and smooth gameplay.

FEATURES:

• 100 carefully designed levels with increasing difficulty
• Challenge mode with various grid sizes and mine densities
• Beautiful visual effects and tactile feedback
• Simple and intuitive controls optimized for Apple Watch
• Track your progress and compete with your best times
• Clean, modern interface that's easy on the eyes

HOW TO PLAY:

Simply tap to reveal a square and hold to flag a potential mine. Use the numbers as clues - they indicate how many mines are in the eight surrounding squares. Clear all safe squares without hitting any mines to win!

PERFECT FOR:

• Quick gaming sessions during breaks
• Training your logical thinking skills
• Classic puzzle fans looking for their favorite game on Apple Watch
• Players of all skill levels - from beginners to minesweeper experts

Mine Quest features both a level mode with 100 progressively challenging puzzles and a free challenge mode where you can test your skills on different field sizes.

Download Mine Quest today and experience the perfect blend of classic gameplay and modern design on your Apple Watch!
en.releaseNotes:
- New dark mode added to help save battery
- Squashed some bugs for a smoother experience
en.subtitle: Casual puzzle, no Wi-Fi needed

zh.trackName: 扫雷大冒险 for watch：专为手表设计的经典益智游戏
zh.description:
扫雷大冒险是一款专为Apple Watch精心设计的扫雷游戏，将经典的益智体验带到你的手腕上，具有优雅的设计和流畅的游戏体验。

游戏特色：
• 100个精心设计的关卡，难度逐步提升
• 挑战模式提供多种网格大小和地雷密度
• 精美的视觉效果和触觉反馈
• 简单直观的控制方式，专为Apple Watch优化
• 跟踪你的进度并挑战自己的最佳记录
• 清晰现代的界面设计，视觉体验舒适
• 纯净体验，无广告
• 离线可玩，无需联网
• 持续更新中，更多主题与模式即将上线

游戏玩法：
轻触屏幕揭开方块，长按标记可能的地雷位置。利用数字作为线索——它们表示周围八个方块中地雷的数量。在不触碰任何地雷的情况下找出所有安全方块即可获胜！

完美适合：
• 休息时间的快速游戏体验
• 训练你的逻辑思维能力
• 寻找Apple Watch上最爱经典游戏的益智游戏爱好者
• 各个技能水平的玩家——从初学者到扫雷专家

扫雷大冒险包含100个难度递增的关卡模式，以及让你可以在不同大小的雷区测试技能的自由挑战模式。

立即下载扫雷大冒险，在你的Apple Watch上体验经典游戏玩法与现代设计的完美结合吧！
zh.releaseNotes:
- 新增暗色模式，晚上玩也不刺眼，更省电～
- 修复了一些小问题，体验更顺滑啦！
